content.text: March 21, 2026 9:05 pm UTC Imagn Images Add The Sporting News on Google The sixth-seeded Louisville Cardinals face the third-seeded Michigan State Spartans in the second round of the 2026 NCAA Tournament. Louisville advanced by beating South Florida 83-79 in the first round on Thursday, while Michigan State convincingly defeated North Dakota State 92-67. The Cardinals (24-10), finished sixth in the ACC at 11-7, are 3-6 against ranked opponents this season. The Spartans (26-7), tied for the second best record in the Big Ten standings at 15-5, are 5-4 against ranked opponents this year.
